definitions.explanation: Complete loss of hope; the state of having no hope left.

examples.japanese: {絶望|ぜつぼう}に{陥|おちい}った。
{絶望的|ぜつぼうてき}な{状況|じょうきょう}だ。
{絶望|ぜつぼう}の{淵|ふち}から{這|は}い{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: I crawled up from the depths of despair.

notes:
{絶望|ぜつぼう} is a powerful word expressing complete loss of hope—utter despair.

WORD FORMATION:
{絶|ぜつ} (to cut off) + {望|ぼう} (hope) = hope cut off

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {絶望|ぜつぼう}する: to despair
- {絶望|ぜつぼう}に{陥|おちい}る: to fall into despair
- {絶望|ぜつぼう}の{淵|ふち}: the depths of despair
- {絶望的|ぜつぼうてき}な{状況|じょうきょう}: hopeless situation

CONTRAST:
- {絶望|ぜつぼう}: despair, hopelessness
- {希望|きぼう}: hope (antonym)
- {失望|しつぼう}: disappointment (less severe)

USAGE:
{絶望|ぜつぼう} is stronger than {失望|しつぼう} (disappointment). It implies a complete, devastating loss of all hope.
